nameJa: ライブ コンサート
headline: Stay in the moment.
prompt:
Create a single finished promotional image in an 11:7 landscape rectangle, exactly 1760 pixels wide and 1120 pixels tall, NOT a panoramic website banner. The image shape is a Chrome Web Store 440 x 280 small promotional tile. All important elements must fit this chunky rectangle and remain striking at thumbnail scale.
Use case: ads-marketing.
Product: YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen, a browser extension putting readable live chat and a usable input over fullscreen streams. This is original illustrative campaign art, not a real screenshot.
Art direction: kinetic music-stream concert editorial photo-art, sophisticated independent music-festival campaign, not generic gaming advertising. Inky black background, vivid saturated cobalt spotlights cutting powerful diagonal shapes down from upper-right, one restrained warm vermilion wash toward the crowd. Rich dark photographic grain, delicate halftone print texture, bold deliberate composition. No actual singer or identifiable performer. Only a low crowd silhouette across the bottom with a few raised hands; anonymous abstract stage lights and haze carry the live energy. No physical monitor or gamer-room setup.
Typography: enormously clear warm off-white contemporary grotesk on the upper-left with generous left margin; exact headline split into two lines "Stay in" then "the moment." Keep all letters inside the canvas. Beautiful strong typographic hierarchy, no outline and no glow. A small restrained label at bottom-left reads exactly "LIVE CHAT FULLSCREEN".
On the right lower half, integrate ONE dark translucent upright chat overlay directly onto the concert scene, around 30% of image width, softly transparent enough that the underlying light beam can be seen but with high-contrast text. It must feel part of the full-screen stream, not a separate framed device. Three spacious short messages with small round abstract avatar dots, exactly "WHAT A SHOW", "Encore!", "Turn it up!". Below them a clean wide dark chat composer field, exactly "Say something..." plus a minimal paper-plane send icon. Crisp UI, generous row spacing and padding, meaningful input visible, no unreadable tiny paragraph text.
Composition must differ from an ordinary SaaS card: huge flat type upper left, diagonal luminous stage / crowd occupying the lower two-thirds, grounded chat integrated at right. Neither text nor chat hides the primary center light energy. Sparse, dramatic, tasteful.
Avoid: all official logos, real celebrities, copyrighted bands, badges, rating stars, decorative charts, neon tech grids, glossy glass panels, 3D gadgets, cars, physical screens, extra floating panels, extra text, watermark. Generate only ONE concept, not a collage/contact sheet.
